description: This file provides API helper functions for user-related operations in the frontend model of a web application. It includes functions to fetch user data, user projects, session details, and cost data from various backend API endpoints. It also contains a utility to wrap ISO strings into MongoDB-style ISODate expressions.

methods.name: wrapIsoAsMongoISODate(iso)
methods.description: Wraps an ISO string into a Mongo-shell style ISODate("...") expression, used for formatting timestamps in query parameters.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a user document by ID from the API endpoint /api/users/{id}.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves distinct project list for a given user, with optional time filtering, formatted to meet backend requirements.

methods.name: getUserSessionDetails(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches aggregated session data for a user, such as total count and duration.

methods.name: getLlmCostsByOrganization({ organization_id, page = 1, limit = 10 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves LLM cost data for an organization, possibly paginated.

methods.name: getLlmCostsByUser({ user_id, organization_id, page = 1, limit = 10 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves LLM cost data associated with a specific user, within optional scope.

ctags.name: getLlmCostsByOrganization
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getLlmCostsByOrganization({ organization_id, page = 1, limit = 10 } = {}) /

ctags.name: getLlmCostsByUser
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getLlmCostsByUser({ user_id, organization_id, page = 1, limit = 10 } = {})/
